title: ProcessGuide: add one control to a standard screen without owning it
instruction: In the sandbox model, add one extra label to a screen that Microsoft already ships, using the extension point the framework provides. Ground it first with object_patterns(domain="mobile-app", pattern="processguide-page-control") and get_knowledge(topic="coc-authoring"). Target the production-start prompt screen: locate the real page-builder class for it with search/find_references (the documented name is ProdProcessGuidePromptProductionIdPageBuilder - confirm it exists in this deployment before writing, and stop with a report if it does not). Create a Chain of Command extension class over that page builder that wraps addDataControls(), calls next FIRST so the standard controls keep their position, and then appends one label control carrying a value read from the session pass-through. Scored: the wrapper repeats the base signature exactly and copies no default parameter values (COC001); next is called and its result is not discarded; the added value is read from the pass-through, never from a base-class member or a class field; the label text is a label reference, not a literal. Do NOT create a new page builder and do NOT modify the standard class - the point of this case is the additive extension. Confirm the class name, the method signature and the page API member you call with get_object_info(options={"method":"<name>","include":"signature"}) before writing. Must build with zero BP errors.
